description: Long-poll for a new message until one past cursor arrives or timeout_s elapses (max 25s), returning the same shape as host.msg.inbox either way -- for a client with no polling loop of its own. On timeout, messages is empty and next_cursor is unchanged.

cursor.description: Opaque; omit to wait for the next message from now.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

timeout_s.description: Max seconds to wait, capped at 25; default 20.

unread_only.description: Filter to messages not yet acked.

name: host.msg.wait
